title: Short-period frequency floor (Figure 3, Category C, Classes I, II-C, IV): Level 2, Category C

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

scale_basis: the magnitude of the lower bound

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: Level 1 floor is NOT printed numerically; graphically read as approximately 0.86 rad/s (line lies between the 0.8 and 0.9 grid lines, ~0.855-0.87). Level 2 floor lies on the 0.6 grid line. Level 3: figure note 'FOR CLASS I, II-C, AND IV AIRPLANES omega_nsp SHALL ALWAYS BE GREATER THAN 0.6 RADIANS PER SECOND FOR LEVEL 3' (strictly greater).
